rationale: The change introduces product semantics and affects runtime and policy across six canonical owners and multiple source and derived paths. Deterministic propagation is unavailable, so the bounded, fail-closed requirements for verified_change are not met; the breadth and policy impact support structured_delivery as the non-authorizing eventual path candidate.
decision_grounds: Synthetic durable UR is approved for measurement only.
Impacts include product semantics, runtime, and policy.
Six canonical owners and eight source paths indicate cross-owner breadth.
Eight derived paths exist, but deterministic propagation is false.
verified_change requires one canonical owner and deterministic propagation when derived paths exist.
compact_delivery is unsupported because completed Brownfield analysis and stored quick_task context are not supplied.
Any impact beyond the supplied facts requires fail-closed escalation.
This classification is a benchmark candidate only and is not an operative Mode/Slice Decision or approval.
